proposedEntry.name: designers-eye
proposedEntry.description: Critiques an uploaded visual (UI screenshot, logo, photo, graphic, PDF-as-image, Figma frame) through 11 named frameworks -- Gestalt principles, visual hierarchy, Itten color science, typography, Muller-Brockmann grid/alignment, Freeman composition, Tufte information design, Rams/Bauhaus reduction, visual balance, Nielsen/Norman usability heuristics, and platform conventions -- and returns a priority-ordered action list (Critical/Important/Polish) where every finding names the violated principle and includes a specific Fix line. Bundles full reference detail for each framework (proximity/similarity/continuity/closure/figure-ground/common-fate/pragnanz/uniform-connectedness violations and fixes; WCAG contrast tables and colour-harmony models; type-scale ratios and readability targets; the 10 Nielsen heuristics with concrete violation examples; web/mobile/social/email/dark-mode platform norms).
triggers: give me honest feedback on this logo
review this mockup against usability heuristics
rank these design issues by severity
inputs: an image, screenshot, PDF-as-image, or Figma frame to critique
optionally a stated platform (web/mobile/social/email) or a specific question to focus the critique
outputs: a severity-ranked list of findings (Critical/Important/Polish), each naming the violated principle and a specific fix
